context_requirements: Active RIPK1-dependent signaling (e.g., TNF-induced necroptosis or inflammatory NF-kB signaling) must be engaged for RIPK1 inhibition to alter transcription
Presence of a stimulus or genetic lesion that activates RIPK1; unstimulated monolayer cultures generally lack RIPK1-dependent transcriptional output
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines after 10 uM RIPK inhibitor treatment
Consistent induction of NF-kB target genes or necroptosis-associated genes across cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across RIPK inhibitors that correlates with RIPK1 target engagement
